label: <DEL> step of length-9 sequences (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step (t=9) of length-9 sequences: every activation in dev is there, and it never fires in the original or copy phases or for any other L. Within that slot it is active on only ~2.4% of sequences, so precision is very low. Which L=9 sequences trigger it depends weakly on content. The first original token (the one about to be output) matters most: o has 6.5x lift and about 25% of the mass, and 1, l, x, n, h are also enriched. The second token r/h/i/o/n/a is also enriched. Even combining first- and second-token sets only reaches F1 ~0.22, so the gating within the slot looks distributed across the whole sequence. Magnitude is small (max 0.026). I did not find a simple modulator of magnitude beyond the first-token enrichment (o is overrepresented among the top examples).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=o (+2.84), orig3=n (+2.06), t=9 & prev_tok=m (+1.81), orig3=w (+1.76), L=9 & recall_idx=0 (+1.65), L=9 & t=9 (+1.65). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.45), in_count=1 (-2.27), orig2=z (-2.13), orig0=u (-1.93).
